item.title: Kat Timpf: The right has an affordability problem
item.description: Why are younger Americans turning toward socialism, and what does that say about the political choices facing both parties? In this episode of “Make It Make Sense,” Carine Hajjar talks with comedian, author and “Gutfeld!” co-host Kat Timpf about her libertarian worldview, the affordability and housing crisis, Donald Trump, the Iran war and the 2026 midterms. They also discuss Timpf’s experience with breast cancer, motherhood and the loss of her father, the future of the Republican Party and why Americans may have more in common than today’s political divisions suggest.
